summary: Completed frontend-only regression of upgraded cursor, alpona motion, 3D sanctuary interactions, translations, and responsive behavior on the public URL. Most core flows pass; a few motion-state and reliability issues remain.

ui_bugs.issue: Reduced-motion dynamic toggle is inconsistent: after switching from reduced->no-preference in-session, pause button sometimes stays disabled.

integration_issues.issue: In one reproducible automation scenario, scene data-animated stayed true after page lost focus (new tab brought front). Requirement expects auto-pause/resume.

integration_issues.flow: Explore navigation reliability during long run
integration_issues.issue: Intermittent timeout waiting for Explore map after nav click in long sequential tests. Later smoke navigation succeeded, so this appears flaky but should be investigated.

issues: Bottom scene-control labels are very small and low-prominence on dense 3D background; readability/accessibility risk on mobile.

action_items: Fix dynamic reduced-motion state propagation so controls and scene animation state always update immediately when OS preference changes.
Verify/fix offscreen visibility handling so Sanctuary animation reliably pauses when tab/page becomes hidden and resumes on return.
Investigate intermittent Explore route readiness under long session transitions (possible route transition/timing race).
Optional UX polish: increase mobile control text size/contrast in Experience bottom bar.
critical_code_review_comments: FestivalCursor native-target guard is broad and correct in intent, but map-cursor behavior should be validated with a deterministic e2e test because runtime verification was flaky.

Sanctuary motion control depends on runtime reduced-motion and visibility signals; current behavior appears non-deterministic across transitions, indicating state synchronization risk between React state and browser media/visibility events.
Repeated WebGL console warnings (GPU stall due to ReadPixels) and context-lost logs observed during long interaction runs; not always user-blocking, but a stability/perf warning worth profiling.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated PASS: tilted trishul visibility, -18deg base tilt, spear-tip transform-origin, click-count increment, hide on textarea/disabled/webgl, gallery lightbox+Tab, 3 hotspots to 03/03, ritual/altar switching, lamps toggle, flowers gating+post-offer lock, reset, expand/Escape, EN/BN ritual-related labels, reduced-motion disables cursor+alpona+scene animation, mobile/tablet rendering and fit checks. Unresolved/flaky: reduced-motion re-enable consistency, visibility auto-pause, intermittent Explore map readiness in long run.
rca of the issue: RCA (likely): motion behavior is controlled by multiple async signals (useReducedMotion hook, motionEnabled local state, IntersectionObserver visibility, document.visibility). During fast preference/page transitions, these sources may desynchronize briefly, leaving pause button disabled or data-animated stale. Reproduction: enter Experience -> emulate/trigger reduced motion -> return to no-preference without full remount in same session -> observe pause button may remain disabled. Visibility check: switching foreground to another tab/page did not always flip data-animated false. Mitigation: centralize animation eligibility in one derived state with explicit media-query and visibility listeners, and force recomputation/remount on reduced-motion preference change.
